title: Sorting
description: Generates 2,000,000 integers with MINSTD, sorts them ascending with the standard library sort and prints first, last, median and a position-weighted checksum.
reveals: Comparison and memory-access efficiency of the default sort.
caveat: Algorithm and stability differ (introsort, pdqsort, timsort, V8 typed-array sort). Node uses Int32Array.sort and Python list.sort on plain ints - the idiomatic fast path of each.
